checks.evidence: “Le responsable peut demander un second contrôle.” is French.
“peut demander un second contrôle” expresses permission rather than an obligation.
“Dans ce cas, l’équipe doit le terminer avant toute publication.” preserves the condition, responsible actor, obligation, and sequence.

ratings.reason: Preserves all source meaning; optionality is conveyed by “peut” rather than stated separately.

checks.evidence: “Le responsable peut demander un second contrôle, sans obligation.” is French.
“peut demander un second contrôle, sans obligation” explicitly preserves both permission and absence of obligation.
“S’il le demande, l’équipe doit le terminer avant toute publication.” preserves the conditional completion requirement.

ratings.reason: Simplifies the source while explicitly retaining every decision-relevant distinction.

cases.preference_reason: Explicitly preserves the absence of obligation without sacrificing simplicity.

checks.evidence: “Von den 190 eingeladenen Personen nahmen 68 an der Befragung teil.” is German.
“nahmen 68 an der Befragung teil. Davon bevorzugten 27 die neue Oberfläche.” retains the respondent denominator.
“190 eingeladenen Personen” retains the invitation count.
“Die Präferenzen der 122 Personen, die nicht teilnahmen, sind unbekannt.” explicitly limits the unknown preferences to nonparticipants and makes no extrapolation.

ratings.reason: Preserves the source and clarifies the remaining group. The count 122 follows directly from 190 minus 68.

checks.evidence: “Von 190 eingeladenen Personen wurden 68 befragt.” is German.
“wurden 68 befragt. Davon bevorzugten 27 die neue Oberfläche.” preserves 27 out of 68.
“Von 190 eingeladenen Personen” retains the invitation count.
“Die Präferenzen der übrigen Personen sind unbekannt.” retains the unknown preferences without extrapolating.

ratings.reason: Preserves all source meaning, although the remaining group is less explicitly identified than in A.

cases.preference_reason: Clarifies exactly whose preferences remain unknown and supplies their directly derivable count.

checks.evidence: “Die Lieferung darf erst nach Zustimmung der Qualitätssicherung freigegeben werden.” is German.
“darf erst nach Zustimmung der Qualitätssicherung freigegeben werden” retains approval as a prerequisite.
“Eine mündliche Zustimmung reicht nicht aus. Die Freigabe muss schriftlich erfolgen.” retains both restrictions.

ratings.reason: Preserves every source requirement in three clear sentences.

checks.evidence: “Die Lieferung darf erst nach Zustimmung der Qualitätssicherung freigegeben werden.” is German.
“darf erst nach Zustimmung der Qualitätssicherung freigegeben werden” retains the prerequisite and sequence.
“Eine mündliche Zustimmung reicht nicht. Die Freigabe muss schriftlich erfolgen.” retains oral insufficiency and written release.

ratings.reason: Preserves every source requirement in three clear sentences.

cases.preference_reason: The difference between “reicht nicht” and “reicht nicht aus” creates no meaningful quality difference.

checks.evidence: “2026年7月の暫定売上は税抜き460万円で” is Japanese.
“2026年7月の暫定売上は税抜き460万円で、前年同月比8％増です。” retains the date, provisional status, amount, currency, and comparison.
“税抜き460万円” explicitly excludes taxes.
“この数値は未監査です。” retains the unaudited status.

ratings.reason: Clearly preserves all source facts and qualifications.

checks.evidence: “2026年7月の暫定売上は、税抜きで460万円です。” is Japanese.
“2026年7月の暫定売上は、税抜きで460万円です。前年同月比で8%増加しました。” retains the date, provisional status, amount, currency, and comparison.
“税抜きで460万円” explicitly excludes taxes.
“この数値はまだ監査されていません。” explicitly retains the not-yet-audited qualification.

ratings.reason: Clearly preserves all source facts and qualifications.

cases.preference_reason: Both are clear, faithful rewrites; their sentence-length differences do not materially affect quality.

checks.evidence: “担当者は任意で追加資料を求めることができ” is Japanese.
“担当者は任意で追加資料を求めることができ” retains the responsible person's permission and optionality.
“申請者は求められた場合、5営業日以内に提出する必要があります。” retains the condition, applicant's obligation, and business-day deadline.

ratings.reason: Preserves all meaning, but combines two distinct rules into a somewhat heavier sentence.

checks.evidence: “担当者による追加資料の要求は任意です。” is Japanese.
“担当者による追加資料の要求は任意です。” retains the responsible person's discretion to request documents.
“要求された場合、申請者は5営業日以内に提出しなければなりません。” retains the conditional obligation and exact deadline.

ratings.reason: Concise and faithful, with the optional request and mandatory response clearly separated.

cases.preference_reason: Separates discretion from the conditional obligation more cleanly and concisely.
